faq.q: Can I send email from my own domain?
faq.a: Yes. Connect your own mail server, sign in with your work email account, or choose one of seven email providers.

faq.q: What happens if my system is down when a webhook is sent?
faq.a: It is retried and logged. After repeated failures the endpoint is paused, and you can replay what was missed.

faq.q: Can I see an API key again after I make it?
faq.a: No. It is shown once, and we keep only a hash of it. If you lose it, make a new one.
